overlay.exampletoast.chongyang.title: Ascending with the Clouds · Double Ninth Festival
overlay.exampletoast.chongyang.line1: May your spirit rise with the autumn heights, clear as the endless sky.
overlay.exampletoast.chongyang.line2: The Tower of Sighs team walks beside you—near in heart, even when far apart.
overlay.exampletoast.new_year.title: A Fresh Dawn · Spring Festival
overlay.exampletoast.new_year.line1: Wishing you joy that lingers, peace that deepens, and a year full of light.
overlay.exampletoast.new_year.line2: The Tower of Sighs team celebrates with you—in blocky worlds and beyond.
overlay.exampletoast.valentine.title: Hearts Afloat · Valentine's Day
overlay.exampletoast.valentine.line1: May your heart be gently seen, warmly held, never left behind.
overlay.exampletoast.valentine.line2: Whether solo or side by side, the Tower of Sighs team walks with you.
